name: ARN Smart Content Toolkit
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
🧠 ARN Smart Content Toolkit is a workflow-first content operations plugin for WordPress.

Instead of simple one-click duplication, the plugin focuses on controlled draft preparation, structured content workflows, title transformation, smart replace operations, and builder-aware content handling.

Users can prepare editable drafts, duplicate content with dynamic title changes, run find-and-replace workflows during duplication, preview actions before execution, and create review-based similar drafts from public URLs.

✅ The plugin is designed for safer editorial workflows — not uncontrolled publishing automation.

Core Workflow Features

🚀 Smart Draft Preparation

Prepare editable drafts before publishing instead of blindly duplicating live content.

✏️ Prepare With New Title

Duplicate content while automatically preparing a completely new title and slug structure.

Useful for:

  • 📄 landing page variations
  • 🛠️ service page workflows
  • 📍 location-based drafts
  • 🗂️ structured editorial preparation

🔄 Smart Find & Replace Workflow

Replace words, phrases, locations, product names, or structured text during the duplication workflow.

This helps users prepare controlled draft variations directly from existing content.

🌐 Similar Draft Workflow

Analyze a public URL, preview detected structure and images, then prepare a review-based editable draft.

⚠️ The workflow is intentionally manual and review-first.

  • No automatic publishing.
  • No autonomous crawling.
  • No background mass scraping.

⚙️ Builder-Aware Content Handling

Designed for modern WordPress editors and structured content workflows.

The plugin detects structured builder content and keeps workflows draft-based for safer manual review before publishing.

Main Features

  • 🖥️ Single workflow screen
  • 🧠 Smart workflow modes
  • 🚀 Smart draft preparation
  • ✏️ Prepare with new title
  • 🔄 Title transformation workflows
  • 🔁 Find & replace while duplicating
  • 🧪 Content variation preparation
  • 🔗 Reference-based editable drafts
  • 🌐 Similar draft workflow
  • 🧩 Builder-aware handling
  • 📦 Controlled batch draft preparation
  • 🛡️ Draft-first workflow
  • ⚡ Quick replace tools
  • 🏷️ Taxonomy move workflow
  • 👁️ Mini preview system
  • 📜 Action history
  • ⚠️ Slug conflict prevention
  • 🖼️ Media-aware handling
  • 🏷️ Taxonomy-aware handling
  • ✍️ Editable draft preparation
  • 🔍 Manual review workflow

Advanced Workflow Tools

✏️ Prepare With New Title

Duplicate content while automatically preparing a completely new title and slug structure.

Useful for:

  • landing page variations
  • service page workflows
  • location-based drafts
  • structured editorial preparation

🔄 Smart Find & Replace Workflow

Replace words, phrases, locations, product names, or structured text during the duplication workflow.

This helps users prepare controlled draft variations directly from existing content.

🧪 Content Variation Preparation

Prepare multiple editable draft variations from existing WordPress content using controlled workflow tools instead of risky live editing.

🌐 Reference-Based Editable Drafts

Create editable review-based drafts from public reference URLs while keeping the workflow manual, controlled, and draft-first.

  • No automatic publishing.
  • No autonomous crawling.
  • No background mass scraping.

💎 Pro Features

ARN Smart Content Toolkit Pro expands the workflow engine with advanced content operations, larger-scale draft workflows, and enhanced builder integrity handling.

Pro is designed for users who manage structured editorial workflows, scalable draft preparation, and advanced content operations inside WordPress.

Find more advanced workflow tools on arnsmart.com.

Pro Workflow Features

🏗️ Advanced Builder Integrity

Enhanced handling for complex structured content and builder-based workflows.

Includes additional integrity and structure protection layers for supported environments.

🌍 Advanced Similar Draft Workflows

Extended draft preparation workflows with improved structure handling and advanced review tools.

⚙️ Advanced Batch Operations

Run larger workflow operations with more advanced draft preparation and structured workflow control.

🧠 Smart Workflow Extensions

Additional workflow tools designed for structured editorial operations and advanced content preparation workflows.

🔁 Extended Replace Operations

Advanced replace and transformation workflows for preparing larger content variations more efficiently.

📈 Workflow Scaling Tools

Additional tools for users handling larger editorial workflows and structured draft operations.

👁️ Advanced Workflow Visibility

Enhanced workflow visibility, action tracking, and operational workflow monitoring tools.

Pro Positioning

ARN Smart Content Toolkit Pro is designed for:

  • 👥 editorial teams
  • 🗂️ structured content workflows
  • 🚀 advanced draft preparation
  • 📊 large-scale content operations
  • 🧩 builder-aware editorial workflows
  • ✅ workflow-first WordPress content management

The free version focuses on controlled draft preparation and lightweight workflow tools.

The Pro version expands the system into a more advanced content operations workflow platform.
sections.installation:
1. 📂 Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. ⚡ Activate ARN Smart Content Toolkit.
  3. 🧩 Open ARN Clonex from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. 🛠️ Use the workflow screen for draft preparation, title changes, replace operations, taxonomy workflows, and preview tools.
  5. 🌐 Use the Similar Draft screen when preparing editable drafts from public reference URLs.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin automatically publish generated drafts?

No. All prepared drafts require manual review and manual publishing by the site administrator.

Does the plugin replace my live content automatically?

No. The plugin uses controlled draft-first workflows designed for safer editorial review.

Does the plugin support structured content workflows?

Yes. The plugin supports workflow-based draft preparation, structured duplication, replace workflows, and builder-aware handling.

Does the plugin create content from external websites automatically?

No. External URL handling is limited, manual, and review-based. The plugin does not perform autonomous publishing or uncontrolled background operations.

Does the plugin support builder-aware workflows?

Yes. The plugin includes builder-aware handling for structured WordPress content workflows and compatible editor environments.
